source: City of Vancouver Open Data, 'Building Footprints 2015' (building-footprints-2015), clipped to the map extent, simplified to ~0.6 m and stripped of footprints under 25 m2. Retrieved 2026-09-22.
encoding: each ring is [x0,y0,dx1,dy1,dx2,dy2,...] in units of 1e-5 degrees from origin; closes implicitly
heightsSource: City of Vancouver Open Data, 'Building Footprints 2009' (building-footprints-2009), field hgt_agl: LiDAR-derived height above ground in metres. Each 2015 footprint takes the height of the 2009 footprint containing its centroid, or the nearest within 12 m; 0 where none matched (built after 2009, or no LiDAR return). Retrieved 2026-09-23.
